<div>
  <div class="blogText">
    <span blogType>PRESS RELEASE</span>
    <h1>Remembering Yamazaki Wakana, 1965-2026</h1>
    <span>22 May 2026</span>
    <br><br><br>
    <p>
      On 16 May 2026, #MamaNyoSquad has learned about the passing of one of the
      greatest pillars of DEAD OR ALIVE (DOA) -- Yamazaki Wakana; Ayane's seiyuu
      -- has passed away last 18 Apr 2026. It was confirmed by her agency, Aoni
      Production; with Oricon first reporting on the news last 15 May at 2pm VIT
      (12pm JST).
    </p>
    <p>She was 61 years old at the time of her passing.</p>
    <p>
      The late announcement was made in order for her family and loved ones are
      mourning over her loss in private.
    </p>
    <p>
      Her colleagues and fans around the world mourn the loss of a legend
      following the grave news, with tributes to the characters that she
      represented in her tenure.
    </p>
    <p>
      Outside of DEAD OR ALIVE, she was mostly known to represent Mouri Ran from
      Detective Conan. Following the obituary notice (and her hiatus months
      prior), Okamura Akemi has been handed the reins to the character.
    </p>
    <p>
      Team NINJA, the team behind the DEAD OR ALIVE series, posted their
      condolences on X:
    </p>
    <br>
    <div class="blogAuthorQuote">
      <p style="margin-bottom: 19px;">
        We were deeply saddened to hear of the passing of Wakana Yamazaki, and
        we offer our heartfelt condolences.
      </p>
      <p style="margin-bottom: 19px;">
        Ms. Yamazaki portrayed the character Ayane in numerous titles over the
        years, including the “DEAD OR ALIVE” and “NINJA GAIDEN” series. We honor
        her achievements during her lifetime and pray for her eternal rest.
      </p>
      <p>The TEAM NINJA Team</p>
    </div>
    <br>
    <p>
      As part of our ongoing effort to wholeheartedly remember Wakana's legacy,
      we have changed our logo -- the first of its kind. It still kept the same
      vibe as the original's, but with purple heart and Ayane instead of red
      heart and Nyotengu. Here's the before-and-after comparison:
    </p>
    <br>

    <br>
    <p>
      In addition, we are planning on conducting a memorial stream honoring her
      legacy, with a playthrough of DOAXVV Global solely for Ayane. The event
      will commence before the delayed-broadcast of DOAXVV Japanese @ 8.5.
    </p>
    <p>
      As aforementioned, our thoughts and prayers are with her family and her
      loved ones at this difficult time.
      <b>May her legacy be known forever, and may she rest in peace.</b>
    </p>
